_comment: Copy this file to config/users.json, edit the entries, then run:
which regenerates config/auth.config.js (the file the browser actually reads).
Never commit config/users.json — it is gitignored. Only auth.config.js, which
contains salted hashes rather than passphrases, is safe to publish.
IMPORTANT: read docs/SECURITY_LIMITATIONS.md before relying on this. A static
site cannot enforce authentication. This gate deters casual link-sharing; it
does not protect the content from anyone who opens developer tools.
